name: FDK Pre-Filtering (Ramp Filter + Cone Weighting)
aliases: CPU FDK Pre-Filter (Ramp Filter + Cone Weighting)
definition: CPU-side implementation of the FDK pre-filtering step, applying cone weighting and a ramp filter via FFT to each projection.
summary: This CPU method prepares 2D projections for backprojection by applying a fixed global ramp filter and explicit geometric cone weighting, distinguishing it from adaptive frequency-domain approaches.
